title: Build a visual automation composer with validation preview
summary: Create a Board experience where a user drags app capabilities into a flow, connects typed inputs and outputs, previews permissions and failure branches, replays scenarios and exports an accepted recipe for HumbleControl review.
acceptance_criteria: The automation recipe has a qualified ID, schema version, owner, purpose, sensitivity, lifecycle state and explicit participating capability versions.
Triggers, conditions, transformations, actions, approval checkpoints, compensation paths and terminal outcomes are represented as a typed graph rather than executable prose.
The user can preview all data fields, repositories, applications, permissions, external effects and retention implications before enabling the recipe.

The primary user journey is: Start from a template or blank Board, discover compatible capabilities, connect a flow, resolve type and policy errors, simulate normal and failure paths and submit a proposal rather than executing it.
A deterministic dry-run replays normal, offline, stale, duplicate, partial, timeout, cancellation, permission-denied and unsupported-version scenarios without real side effects.
The recipe declares idempotence keys and deduplication rules so retries or duplicate events cannot create repeated tasks, messages, payments, writes or imports.
Partial acceptance and partial failure remain visible per step; a successful early step never hides a failed or blocked later action.
The user can pause, disable, amend, supersede or revoke the recipe without deleting historical receipts or rewriting completed domain events.
Permission and consent are evaluated at enable time and again immediately before each sensitive action; revoked or expired authority blocks the action.
External communication, financial writes, hardware control, public publication, deletion, restore and health-adjacent recommendations always retain their required interactive checkpoints.
Offline execution uses only capabilities that declare an offline contract; queued work exposes expiry, retry and conflict posture rather than pretending completion.
Every run emits step-level receipts, quality evidence, source revisions, outcomes, limitations and a clear correlation to the recipe and user decision.
The experience explains why a trigger matched, why an action is proposed or skipped and what evidence or rule produced the result.
Accessible keyboard/navigation support, Dynamic Type or platform-equivalent scaling, localization and reduced-motion behavior cover the complete setup and review flow.
Privacy-safe adoption evidence distinguishes eligibility, exposure, activation, first value, failure, opt-out and support need without collecting unrelated content.
Fixtures and focused tests cover enablement, preview, confirmation, success, failure, compensation, restart/resume, revocation and recipe migration.
Repository-native build, tests, conformance checks and the strongest practical zero-warning gate pass.

agent_notes: Portfolio Composability & Automation Wave 7; repository-owned capability and safe automation planning ticket.
Estimated effort: L to XL after all prerequisites; split implementation into bounded Work Packages.
Implementation risk: medium-high; safety class: visual-authoring.
External portfolio prerequisites: mrPoky/HumbleControl#HC-0186, mrPoky/HumbleControl#HC-0187, mrPoky/HumbleControl#HC-0189.
Non-scope: Do not execute the visual flow, grant permissions, hide incompatible edges or mutate app source truth from the composer.

Alternative considered and rejected: Draw automations as generic diagram nodes — rejected because generic nodes cannot prove schema compatibility, permission requirements, error routing or executable identity.
Run a fresh delta review against the current default branch before publication or implementation.

Wave 8 portfolio reassessment: retain-conditional; priority band later. Capability and automation contracts may support the professional environment, but each application remains independent by default.
Wave 10 final rationalization: consolidate-into-agent-platform; portfolio band later. Keep capability and automation contracts as bounded platform work, not app-wide requirements.
Wave 11 execution reconciliation: `optional-reference-or-research`. Use the Wave 11 implementation program as the delivery entry point while preserving this ticket's evidence and intent.

Wave 12 deep reassessment: decision `retain-research`, relevance `later`, current priority `medium`, execution gate `bounded platform pilot with explicit permissions`. Capability and automation contracts may support the platform environment but remain optional until concrete operators exist.
Wave 13 human-validation reassessment: `retain-platform-research` / `later` / priority `medium`. Generic capability and automation layers remain optional until dogfooding proves value.

Final Wave 14 validity review: `valid-research-or-reference`; publication `publish-as-proposed-backlog`; implementation sequence `later`. Generic capability and automation layers remain optional until dogfooding proves value.
